title: Code Proof
user: Engineers and technical writers producing long Markdown manuals who need to catch broken code blocks, wrapping, and internal links in the final PDF.
smallest_useful_product: A local CLI that renders Markdown through a chosen engine, checks PDF annotations and page geometry, flags overflowing/unhighlighted fenced blocks, and emits an HTML proof sheet.
constraints: Do not execute embedded HTML/JavaScript with network access; sandbox renderer subprocesses; make checks engine-specific and reproducible.
